title: Design: Dropdown of a customer on an inactive term lists it last
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure a customer is on Net 50.
  • Make sure Net 50 is deactivated.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design pictures ct-p6-05-this-customer-s-picker.png, ct-p7-07-edit-vendor-keeps-the-inactive-term.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the customer page of that customer.
custom_steps:
1. Click the pencil on the customer card.
  2. Click the "Credit Terms" box.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Edit Customer" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The list shows the active terms in the page's order with no "Net 50" among them, then, last, "Net 50 (Inactive)", selected (highlighted).
  • Compare ct-p6-05-this-customer-s-picker.png for the list and ct-p7-07-edit-vendor-keeps-the-inactive-term.png for the last row (the customer drawing is cut off before that row).

Step 3:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R7: “On Edit Customer, a customer whose term was deactivated shows it as "{name} (Inactive)" in the dropdown, selected, listed after the active terms.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
